title: IEEE Hyderabad Section Student Branches, SN Team, Faculty Advisors and Branch Counselors online meeting|22nd February 2026 at 5:00 PM.
description:
IEEE Hyderabad Section Student Branches, SN Team, Faculty Advisors and Branch Counselors online meeting|22nd February 2026 at 5:00 PM.

Dear Members,
Greetings!
An online meeting with all IEEE Hyderabad Section Student Branches, SN Team, Faculty Advisors, and Branch Counselors is scheduled on 22 February 2026 at 5:00 PM. You are kindly requested to attend the meeting along with 2–3 active student representatives from your branch. Please block your calendar accordingly.
All newly formed Student Branches are requested to complete the data collection form. If already submitted, kindly ignore this message.
Form Link: https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSdLgYK5SKGvIKwrJKkmgUYzHlUjag24d1tJlXUBZWqL-PLCGQ/viewform

IGNITE–IED 2026 | Empowering Innovation & Entrepreneurship
IEEE WIE India Council, under the Golden Jubilee Celebrations of IEEE India Council, in collaboration with IEEE Hyderabad Section SAC and IEEE Delhi Section SAC & WIE, is organizing IGNITE–IED: One Week Online Workshop on “Innovation and Entrepreneurship Development” from 23–27 February 2026, 7:00 PM – 8:30 PM (IST), in online mode.
The workshop aims to foster entrepreneurial thinking, innovation strategy, startup readiness, and responsible leadership among students, researchers, and young professionals.

Distinguished IEEE Leaders: Prerna Gaur – Chair, IEEE India Council (Chief Guest); Suresh Nair – Chair, IEEE R10 Adhoc Committee on Entrepreneurship & Innovation (Guest of Eminence); Rajashree Jain – Treasurer, IEEE India Council.

Key Themes: Hardware & Software Prototyping; Lean Canvas & Startup Models; Technology Readiness Levels (TRLs); Startup Funding & Pitch Deck Development; Branding, Communication & Strategy; Problem Discovery & Idea Generation.

Open to Students | Researchers | Young Professionals. Speakers from IEEE, Academia, and Industry.
This initiative reflects IEEE’s continued commitment to building a strong innovation and entrepreneurship ecosystem across India.
Looking forward to your active participation and meaningful discussions.
